To: invoices@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change of legal entity / remit address for EvenCore invoices

Hi Redwood billing team,

Quick note from EvenCore: as of May 1 we've consolidated billing under our parent, EvenCore Holdings, Inc. Could you please reissue the outstanding invoice and route future invoices to the new remit? Details below: 

Legal name: EvenCore Holdings, Inc.
Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
DUNS: 78-901-2345 (attached as text file)
New remit email: accounts-payable@evencore.com
New remit address: 1200 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107
PO for outstanding invoice: PO-4567

We're attaching the W-9 and a DUNS export. Let us know if you need a formal amendment or a signed SID (billing change form). We want the change effective for any invoices generated on/after 2027-05-01.

Thanks,
Maya Ortiz
Procurement Manager
EvenCore Holdings
maya.ortiz@evencore.com
(415) 555-0191

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments.

Quick confirmation questions so we process this cleanly:
- Can you confirm which customer account ID we should map to EvenCore Holdings (is it the same account: EVEN-67890)?
- For the outstanding invoice INV-20270430-321 (due 2027-05-30), do you want Redwood to reissue a single corrected invoice to EvenCore Holdings, Inc. and mark the previous one void?
- Is wire transfer still the preferred payment method for EvenCore, or will ACH be used going forward?

Looping in Marcus from finance to handle reissue and Laura from legal to flag any contract-side naming implications. Priya I cc'd to keep the account owner in the loop on the change and the PO alignment. We'll aim to have a reissued invoice to you within 24 business hours once Marcus confirms.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
